downloads.label: Sanitized private-path verification client (Python)
downloads.description: Source-derived, parameterized diagnostic for a system-assigned managed identity on an Azure VM. No infrastructure mutations; explicit opt-in sends one billable inference request. Output excludes response bodies and environment identifiers. Not identical to the source and not cloud-tested during publication.

omissions: Private source locations, original file and resource names, source commit and client fingerprint values, subscription and tenant identifiers, endpoints, IP addresses, user paths, credentials, raw responses and original screenshots are not published.

The historical record contains one successful inference call before and one after migration, not continuous availability monitoring, latency measurements, rollback execution, API-key continuity testing or validation of new Foundry features.

The companion is an independently sanitized adaptation with address pinning and reduced output, not the unchanged historical client. Publication checks are offline only; no Azure calls or resource changes were performed.

Environment-specific backups, deployment templates, DNS exports and automated destructive cleanup are intentionally omitted. Review the current service documentation and your organization's change controls before adapting the examples.
